page_title: ALA 1-0 CAD | Alaves v Cadiz CF 19/01/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+8' There will be no more action in this match as the referee signals full time.
90+3' The attendance for today's match is 15838.
90+2' Here is a change. Luis Rioja is going off and Luis Garcia Plaza gives the last tactical orders to Giuliano Simeone (Alaves).
90+2' Antonio Blanco will be replaced by Nahuel Tenaglia (Alaves).
90' The fourth official shows 7 min. of added time.
89' Let's have a look at statistics for the fouls committed by both teams – 15:16.
88' Sergio has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Iza Carcelen (Cadiz) replacing Lucas Pires.
87' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Alvaro Negredo (Cadiz) is coming onto the pitch as Joseba Zaldua cannot continue after picking up an injury.
86' Alaves have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
84' Substitution. Jon Guridi did his best and is replaced by Carlos Benavidez (Alaves).
76' Substitution. Alex Sola (Alaves) receives a signal from the referee and is now allowed to enter the pitch as Carlos Vicente walks off.
75' Sergio decides to make a substitution. Gonzalo Escalante will be replaced by Alex Fernandez (Cadiz).
75' Substitution. Samu Omorodion (Alaves) in, Kike Garcia out.
70' The game has come to an end for Sergio Guardiola. He has contributed as much as he could today. He will be replaced by the fresh legs of Etta Eyong (Cadiz).
70' Sergio has decided to make a change. Brian Ocampo (Cadiz) replaces Ivan Alejo.
68' Fali (Cadiz) has tested the patience of referee Alejandro Ruiz and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
67' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Alaves comes to nothing.
58' Alaves failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
58' Alaves move the ball around well as they wait for an opportunity to shoot, but the attack is halted as they lose possession. The linesman points to the corner flag, Alaves are going to take it.
53' Cadiz CF can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
51' 1 - 0 Goal! Luis Rioja (Alaves) wins the battle of wills and sends an unstoppable penalty past Conan Ledesma into the bottom left corner.
51' Luis Rioja (Alaves) is going to take the penalty!
50' Lucas Pires (Cadiz) goes into the book for bad language. His vulgar comments could have made it worse. Luckily for him, it's a yellow card.
49' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Ivan Alejo (Cadiz) was quite harsh and Alejandro Ruiz didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.

49' Ivan Alejo (Cadiz) gives away a foul for a clumsy challenge. Referee Alejandro Ruiz saw the whole situation. PENALTY! Wonderful opportunity to score for Alaves. Penalty awarded! Alaves will take a penalty kick.
49' Handball! A player from Alaves handled the ball. Free kick. Cadiz CF will probably just try to cross the ball in from here.
46' The game restarts for the second half.
45+2' The first half of today's match has just finished.
45+1' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Alaves.
45' 1 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
45' A player from Cadiz CF commits a rough challenge. Alejandro Ruiz blows for a foul and keeps the game under control. A free kick has been awarded to Alaves.
44' The resulting set piece from Cadiz CF is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
43' Carlos Vicente (Alaves) floats the free kick into the box, but it's easily cleared by the first man.
42' The referee blows his whistle as Ivan Alejo (Cadiz) was too aggressive in his challenge. Alaves are awarded a free kick.
39' Alaves are bossing possession at the moment by exchanging some precise passes from player to player.
36' Kike Garcia (Alaves) should know this behaviour is beyond the rules. He was too careless with his challenge and left Alejandro Ruiz no option but to blow his whistle. Cadiz CF win a free kick.
34' Cadiz CF concede a free kick following a bad challenge. Alaves are awarded the free kick.

29' A player from Cadiz CF commits a rough challenge. Alejandro Ruiz blows for a foul and keeps the game under control. It's a free kick to Alaves, but they probably won't attempt a direct shot on goal from here.
28' Ander Guevara (Alaves) commits a foul and Alejandro Ruiz immediately signals a free kick. A free kick has been awarded to Cadiz CF.
25' Carlos Vicente (Alaves) sends in a lofted cross from a mid-range free kick, but his poor effort goes out of play. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Cadiz CF.
25' Alejandro Ruiz interrupts the game. One of the players from Cadiz CF won the ball, but his effort is adjudged unfair. Alaves will take a free kick near the side line.
22' This is a yellow card! Sergio Guardiola (Cadiz) is not happy with the decision, but from our point of view it was clear.
21' Cadiz CF fail to score from a corner as Antonio Sivera (Alaves) leaps to collect the ball.
21' Cadiz CF are enjoying possession, but one of the opposition players steps in to end the sequence. Cadiz CF win a corner.
17' A player from Cadiz CF commits a rough challenge. Alejandro Ruiz blows for a foul and keeps the game under control. Alaves will take a free kick.
16' One of the defenders reacts at the last minute to brilliantly block a pass from Luis Rioja (Alaves). It's a throw-in for Alaves.

15' Sergio Guardiola (Cadiz) creates a yard of space for himself and tries an effort from the edge of the box, but it goes just wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Alaves will have a goal kick.
15' Cadiz CF take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.

14' Sergio Guardiola (Cadiz) wins the ball near the penalty spot and unleashes a header towards the roof of the net, but Antonio Sivera is alert and denies him. Good work from Cadiz CF as they win a corner.
13' Ivan Alejo (Cadiz) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out.
12' Alaves keep the ball well and push forward with purpose, but here comes an interception from the opposition.

12' Kike Garcia (Alaves) attempts to score as he rises near the penalty spot and heads the ball to the middle of the goal. Conan Ledesma pulls off a comfortable save to stop the ball from hitting the net.
10' Carlos Vicente (Alaves) attempts to send over a cross in order to find one of his teammates, but an opposition defender averts the danger by intercepting the effort.

9' A clever short pass gives Carlos Vicente (Alaves) a clear goal scoring opportunity, but he fluffs his lines and rifles the ball high over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Cadiz CF.
5' Alejandro Ruiz interrupts the game. One of the players from Alaves won the ball, but his effort is adjudged unfair. Cadiz CF earn a free kick.

3' Antonio Blanco (Alaves) controls a square pass, he moves forward then unleashes a wild shot from mid-range which goes so far wide it nearly hits the corner flag. The ball goes out of play and Cadiz CF will have a goal kick.
2' A player from Cadiz CF commits a rough challenge. Alejandro Ruiz blows for a foul and keeps the game under control. A free kick to Alaves.
1' The first half has just begun.
The players are on the pitch and Cadiz CF will have the kick-off.
Alejandro Ruiz was nominated as the referee for this game.
